Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 6  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made an error in their analysis by confusing the lineage of Chiang Hsiao-chang. The WebSurfer correctly identified Chiang Hsiao-chang's father as Chiang Ching-kuo, and listed her siblings as Hsiao-wen, Hsiao-wu, and Hsiao-yung. However, the Planner incorrectly concluded that Chiang Kai-shek (Chiang Ching-kuo's father) was directly relevant to the question, and mistakenly identified Chiang Wei-kuo as the "other child" of Chiang Hsiao-chang's father, when in fact the task was to identify a sibling of Chiang Hsiao-chang, who is one of the three brothers mentioned.
